name.value: Best Western Premier Chateau Granville Hotel & Suites & Conference Centre

description.value: A 118-room boutique-style hotel operating since 1975 in Vancouver's Entertainment District, at the corner of Granville and Helmcken streets — three minutes' walk from the Yaletown–Roundhouse Canada Line station. The property offers some of the largest one-bedroom suites on Granville Street, with private balconies and layouts that sleep up to five guests. Its downtown location puts cyclists within walking distance of the seawall, Stanley Park, Granville Island (via Aquabus), and the full length of the Seaside Greenway.
